title: Drive Forms — Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: Three drive forms the player can unlock and shift into during combat.

forms.name: Shadow Overdrive
forms.flavor: The heartless half of the Twilight Keyblade surges. Zero's form darkens — speed and strength spike, defense and magic gutter.

forms.name: Ultima Drive
forms.flavor: The light half of the Twilight Keyblade surges. Zero splits into a storm of light and dark fragments — high magic, high cost.

forms.name: Twilight Form
forms.flavor: The Twilight Keyblade balances light and dark. Oblivion and Oathkeeper activate simultaneously — balanced stats, five keyblade echoes.
